name: ice_zone_milankovic_v2
description: Corrected bluish (ice-consistent) zones, Geury, 2026-11-14. v1 was shifted ~160 m south by an offset in converting the HiRISE COLOR browse (ESP_071006_2345_COLOR.abrowse.jpg) to lat/lon; v2 registers the browse to the team's traced face (scarp_lines.geojson; median offset 57.7 browse px = 0.00274 deg lat). Bluish = blue > red+25 and > green+15 in the enhanced-color browse (2.8 m/px). Bluish tones are CONSISTENT WITH water ice, not proof (Dundas et al. 2018; CRISM confirmed ice at 3 of 8 scarps, none confirmed for this face). Lon east-positive in -180..180.

properties.label: Main face, west and middle: bluish (consistent with ice)
properties.blue_fraction: 19-89% of face pixels per ~55 m segment; strongest -147.915 to -147.912 (52-89%), moderate -147.907 to -147.900 (22-47%)
properties.notes: Same face as scarp_lines.geojson (v1 'main band' after offset correction). Tall part of the face (60-72 m); crew cannot reach it on this EVA; drone perch faces it.

properties.label: Main face, east end: NOT bluish in the color strip
properties.notes: This is the 23-35 m section the crew viewpoint faces. Inside the color strip, but gray/dark, not bluish: debris-covered or too narrow to resolve at 2.8 m/px. Not evidence of exposed ice.

properties.label: Upper band on the lobe's north-east margin: bluish (consistent with ice)
properties.notes: Not in scarp_lines.geojson. Nearest bluish pixel is ~30 m from the DTM viewpoint and ~66 m from the backup viewpoint. If it is a north-facing scarp, its edge/rockfall zone is NOT modeled yet: needs tracing and a setback check. It may also be the crew's best ice-consistent target.

properties.label: Southern scarp band (~3 km south), offset-corrected
properties.notes: v1 'ice_south' shifted +0.00274 deg. Separate scarp; position approximate (+/-15 m).
